new_study.question: Do balanced and contrarian derived terms add independent candidate information to the five-component mean-z consensus?
new_study.result: The terms algebraically duplicate recent30 and gap, adding one extra gap vote. Removing both did not produce a candidate-recall CI excluding zero; the fixed three-line portfolio failed all four strict CI conditions and any2 positive block share was 9/17.
